channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Mullin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Mullin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rick Barry on Chris Mullin
item.description:
“I got Chris Mullin to finally start playing, and his wife (Liz) is fanatical about it,”

Rick Barry on Chris Mullin, Oct 17, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Chris Mullin, Tim Hardaway, Mitch Richmond
item.description:
Pop on what Warriors' Run TMC - Tim Hardaway, Mitch Richmond & Chris Mullin - meant to the league:

“It was cool, it was fast-paced, it was creative, people really bought into it. It was a wonderful time in the NBA, and these guys were one of the best shows available for sure.”

Gregg Popovich on Chris Mullin, Tim Hardaway, Mitch Richmond, Nov 14, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kevin Love on Chris Mullin
item.description:
Minnesota's Kevin Love said Saturday night.

“I think it influenced kind of everybody around the league, and that's kind of where everybody's headed. I think I saw Chris Mullin talking about it (Friday) night, that that's kind of the unconventional way right now. You see them recruit superstars, (and) in some ways having problems, rather than looking at the Lakers, where they have a couple (of superstars), or the San Antonio Spurs, where it's more of the conventional way of putting teams together.”

Kevin Love on Chris Mullin, Mar 7, 2011. Source: NBA.com.
